How to play

Rules of the road

MoveSwipe left or right to change lane. Swipe up to jump, down to slide.
JunctionsAbout every minute the road ends in a T. Swipe left or right at the corner to pick your next district. Miss it and you run into the kiosk.
BridgesRun up a flyover ramp to ride on top, safe from traffic and full of notes. Or stay underneath; just no jump too high.
MoneyGrab eko notes. Keep grabbing without stumbling to build your combo up to ×5. Night notes pay 1.5×.
HeatEvery stumble raises police heat. Run clean and it cools. Full heat and the officer catches you.
BribesTap Settle when heat is high. Run into a union tout and pay Ɇ1,000 levy, and his boys hold the police for you.
CaughtSettle the officer to keep running, or go to station and bank your cash.
UltimateNotes charge your ult. When it's full, tap ULT or double-tap the screen.
StatesLagos, Port Harcourt, Abuja, Kano and Enugu, each with its own districts and its own palava. Black soot in PH, harmattan in Kano and rain in Enugu make notes pay 1.25×.
TravelEvery runner has a journey. At the end of each state you board a bus, train or plane. At each stop you can save and stop, or keep going to the end of the route for a big bonus.
Daily routeEvery day there is one runner and one journey for everybody, with its own leaderboard. New route at midnight.
FestivalsEvery weekend, Friday to Sunday, one state holds a festival: Eyo, Durbar, Mmanwu or carnival. Processions fill the road and notes pay double there.
ChallengeAfter a run, share your score card. The link lets your friend run the same runner and route to beat you. Leaderboards also have a This week view that starts again every Monday.
